name: Miranda Reed
source:
COSA commander and official supervisor of the Aegis, Miranda stands out for her strict and rational demeanor. Dutiful and bound to protocol, she bases her decisions on her scionic ability, which grants her a tactical insight capable of anticipating others' reactions. This control, fueled by rigid pragmatism and an almost pathological need for order, has always hindered her from building a fulfilling private life.
